title: Parts bin shelving with plastic bins (Machine Shop and Factory Hall)
description: Blue shelving 1.2 m wide and 1.9 m tall carrying four rows of open fronted cream and blue picking bins, with a written card on the end frame. Free 3D model for machine shop, factory and industrial game scenes in Unity, Godot, Unreal, three.js and Blender. Overall 1.28 by 2.05 by 0.55 m (X by Y by Z). Metre units, +Y up, the operator side toward +Z, resting on y=0 with the origin on the footprint. Static geometry; no rig, collision or navigation data. Static piece; the bins do not lift out.
